images.title: The playground of turns
images.purpose: Gather the ideas of the chapter in one picture: six small scenes of the playground, one for each idea.
images.composition: Six equal cells in two rows of three, each with one small diagram and a caption.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Six cells, each 440 by 330 px with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline and a very pale cream #FFF8E7 fill, in two rows: row 1 at y 70 to 400, row 2 at y 430 to 760; columns at x 40 to 480, x 508 to 948 and x 976 to 1416. Each cell holds one simple flat diagram in the upper part and a caption in dark #1F2937 sans-serif (32 px, bold) centred 40 px above the cell's bottom edge. CELL 1 (row 1, left): a thin grey ring with a teal start arrow pointing up and an amber half-moon trace on its right half; caption Full turn and half turn. CELL 2 (row 1, middle): a wheel (a circle with 4 spokes) with 4 amber quarter arrows round it; caption Halves and quarters. CELL 3 (row 1, right): two straws from one corner, one teal and one amber, with a red #D55E00 arc and a small square corner mark; caption Right, acute, obtuse and straight. CELL 4 (row 2, left): a disc cut into 8 equal parts with an amber wedge of 2 parts; caption Eighths, sixths and twelfths. CELL 5 (row 2, middle): a clock face with the numbers 12, 3, 6 and 9, a teal minute hand and an amber sweep from 12 to 3; caption The minute hand. CELL 6 (row 2, right): a compass cross with the letters N, E, S and W and one curved amber arrow going the way a clock moves; caption Clockwise and anti-clockwise. No fractions or numbers other than those listed. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any text other than the listed captions and letters
images.takeaway: The chapter's ideas, from the full turn to clockwise, are all about turning.
images.description: Six small scenes of the playground in two rows: a ring, a wheel, two straws, a disc, a clock and a compass, each with a short caption.
images.context: Concept image for the chapter revision. It follows the whole chapter in your maths book and gives each idea one small picture.
images.teaching_notes: Point to each cell and ask which idea it holds. Nothing new is taught on this picture.

image_decisions.why: One picture with a cell for each idea works as a map of the chapter for the revision.
